svg.aria-label: 6161 · BOARD LAYOUT (DERIVED) — redrawn board layout diagram, layout-sheet drafting style
svg.text: Redrawn from Valco factory drawing, title block "Valco Model 6161" — layout DERIVED from that circuit drawing; Valco published no board-layout sheet for this chassis and none was located — not a trace

Heater layer: no factory board-layout drawing exists for this amplifier, so its heater wiring cannot be read off one. At the centre-tapped valves (V2, V3) it shows the two heater pins on opposite supply legs — the 12.6 V series arrangement; a 6.3 V supply straps them into one leg and returns on the centre tap. The valves on the chain are this circuit's own; the order the chain reaches them in is this drawing's convention.
Note: the heater wiring always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
6.3 V heaters — twisted pair (leg grouping not established)
6.3 V heaters — single lead (leg grouping not established)
